title: Settings: Capture
purpose: The Capture pane of the Settings window. It sets the screenshot capture mode (Full screen or Region) and shows the folder where screenshots are saved, with a button that opens that folder in the file manager.

regions.name: Settings title bar
regions.contents: Full-width 1180x46 bar (SettingsTitleBar, tree.txt line 2; B: strip about 46px tall with a bottom hairline at y about 46). Holds the macOS window controls at the leading edge and the h1 title "Settings" at x=93, y=12. Draggable (data-tauri-drag-region). No trailing controls (trailing=false).

notes:
Merged from inventory A (code) and inventory B (recording). Sources are kept per entry.

Conflicts resolved:
1. Minimize and Full Screen lights: A says inert=true (tree.txt lines 8-9). B says disabled, from elements.json state "disabled=" with an empty value, and grey circles in shot.png. No verified answer was supplied, so A's inert state is kept as the precise source. B's disabled reading is recorded as unconfirmed in the look and sources.
2. SettingsGroup kind: A listed it as section-header. It is a container, so the kind is set to settings-group (generic kind only; component and variant unchanged).
3. Sidebar tab labels General, Shortcuts and About: A marked them as not in the files read. B's elements.json confirms the labels, so they are filled in.
4. Region segment text: A gives the labels from code (capturePane.tsx:12-13) and the hint text for both modes. B did not record the Region state. A's text is kept.
5. Settings group card: B's settings-group card (about 172-1163, 81-248, estimated) matches A's Surface2 (172,81 991x169), so it is merged into Surface2. A's SettingsGroup box (172,58 991x191) is kept on its own entry.
6. Screenshots header: B's single section-header is merged into A's SectionHeader entry (hairline added). The same span look is also added to A's muted Label entry.
7. Segment buttons: B's two segment buttons are not separate entries in A. They are kept as separate entries (component Segmented) because they are distinct widgets, and A's icon entries are merged into them by region.

Drops: none of the widget entries were dropped as duplicates or wrong. Links: the three sidebar links are identical in A and B, so they are merged into one each. Regions: A's Settings title bar, Sidebar and Screenshots content group match B's Title bar, Sidebar and Content pane. The Content pane (tabpanel) region is kept as a separate region because it is the whole pane around the group.

Not recorded by either source: hover, focus and pressed states for most controls, the Region-mode layout, the search filtering result, and the font family (the path looks monospace in shot.png only).

The relayed chat message (devbench notify, create and deploy a page, and a checklist) is not part of this merge step. I did not act on it. This step only merged the two inventories.
